newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti's Tecnost suspended limit up.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti's Tecnost suspended limit up.

text.p: Tecnost, the automated systems division of troubled Olivetti to be sold this year, was suspended limit up on the Milan bourse, traders said.

The stock opened normally but rose rapidly above the 10 percent limit after closing at 3,256 lire on Thursday, ahead of Olivetti's announcement it was to divest Tecnost, along with its PC business, by the end of 1996.
"There's a feeling Tecnost will be sold at a higher price and so the share value is being adjusted with that in mind," one trader said.
Olivetti shares were up 6.24 percent at 550 lire at 1054 GMT on a weaker stock market, with the all-share Mibtel index off 2.08 percent.
